facts.content: The SaaS starter prompt was evaluated for potential expansion with enterprise-level phases but was determined to be sufficiently robust without them.
The YAGNI principle was applied to maintain focus on production-ready foundations for startups instead of mimicking legacy enterprise systems.
MVP readiness and shipping speed were prioritized over over-engineering in the SaaS starter prompt design.
Rapid deployment and core functionality were prioritized over complex infrastructure in the prompt scope.
